one_line: Paired portrayal of Emperor Jahangir and his rival Malik Ambar, visualizing Mughal dream-propaganda during the Deccan wars.

appearance.age_look: Jahangir appears as a lean man in his late 30s, poised and regal; Malik Ambar appears as a sturdy man in his 50s, dignified and resolute.
appearance.face: Jahangir has an oval, light-brown face with sharp nose, thin moustache, and calm, focused eyes; Malik Ambar has a broad, dark-brown face with high cheekbones, full lips, and steady, intense eyes; both default to serious, self-possessed expressions.
appearance.hair: Jahangir’s hair is black, tied in a neat bun under a tall, pale-cream Mughal turban wrapped with fine gold bands and a single emerald-green plume at the front; Malik Ambar’s short, tightly curled black hair is mostly covered by a plain white Deccan-style turban, low and snug, with no feather.
appearance.costume: Jahangir wears a fitted, knee-length Mughal jama of soft pale peach silk with fine gold floral trellis patterns, a narrow emerald-green sash at the waist, straight white churidar trousers, and simple pale-brown leather shoes; over his shoulders a light, translucent shawl with faint gold edging; Malik Ambar wears a practical Deccan-style long tunic in deep indigo cotton reaching mid-thigh, a sleeveless buff-coloured quilted armor vest over it, loose off-white trousers, sturdy dark-brown leather boots, and a plain dark-brown leather belt with a small utilitarian pouch; his overall look is austere and functional.
appearance.signature: Jahangir holds a slim, elegant Persianate sword with a slightly curved steel blade and a jeweled hilt of gold with green and red stones, the scabbard in deep red leather with gold fittings; Malik Ambar carries a simple, slightly curved steel talwar with an unadorned dark wooden hilt and plain brown scabbard, worn at his left hip.

ref_desc: Jahangir has a light-brown oval face, neat turban, pale peach gold-patterned jama, emerald sash and jeweled curved sword, while Malik Ambar has a dark-brown broad face, simple white turban, indigo tunic with buff quilted vest, plain trousers and an unadorned talwar at his hip, using pale peach, emerald green, indigo, white and gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw two full-body anime-style historical characters standing side by side: Emperor Jahangir and Malik Ambar, rendered with Mughal–Deccan accuracy. Jahangir is lean, late-30s, light-brown oval face with sharp nose and thin moustache, calm focused eyes, and a neat black hair bun under a tall pale-cream Mughal turban wrapped in fine gold bands with a single emerald-green plume. He wears a fitted, knee-length pale peach silk jama covered in delicate gold floral trellis patterns, a narrow emerald-green sash around his waist, straight white churidar trousers, simple pale-brown leather shoes, and a light translucent shawl with faint gold edging over his shoulders. In his right hand he holds a slim Persianate sword with a slightly curved steel blade and a jeweled gold hilt set with green and red stones, its deep red leather scabbard tipped in gold. Malik Ambar stands beside him, sturdy and in his 50s, with a broad dark-brown face, high cheekbones, full lips, and steady intense eyes; his short tightly curled black hair is mostly covered by a snug, plain white Deccan-style turban without a feather. He wears a long deep indigo cotton tunic reaching mid-thigh, covered by a sleeveless buff-coloured quilted armor vest, loose off-white trousers, and sturdy dark-brown leather boots, with a plain dark-brown leather belt and small pouch at his waist. At his left hip hangs his signature simple talwar: a slightly curved steel blade with an unadorned dark wooden hilt and plain brown scabbard. Use pale peach, emerald green, indigo blue, white, and gold as dominant colours, and present them front-facing in a neutral pose so their faces, hair, costumes, and weapons are clearly visible for consistent redrawing.
